title: vstack Manifest
description: Project-level manifest identifying the vstack workspace and content version. Located at .vstack/manifest.json

vstackVersion.description: Semantic version of the vstack runtime that created this workspace

contentVersion.description: Content version identifier for the playbook/content installed in this project

projectId.description: Unique project identifier derived from the repository root

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this workspace was first initialized

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last workspace update
